method: Multi-agent editorial & cohesion comb-through of every rendered wiki page (6 agents, clustered by chapter) plus a mechanical link/anchor integrity scan. Axis: does the wiki read as one cohesive product for clinicians, developers and product? This is NOT the spec build-readiness audit (missing formulas/constants live there). Severity: high = visibly wrong / breaks the 'one product' feel; med = inconsistency a reader will notice; low = polish. All pages are generated — fixes belong in the source / builders, never the .html. Items marked 'fixed' were corrected in the same session (defects in the newly-added chapter landing pages).

findings.finding: The glossary page conventions.html is almost always linked with the visible text “README” (e.g. “README §5.6”), and the binding blockquote opens with a bare, unlinked “README.md §3”. A reader cannot tell “README” = the Conventions & glossary.
findings.fix: Relabel visible “README” link text to “Conventions” and link the bare README.md reference (one builder fix propagates everywhere).

findings.finding: Glossary omits load-bearing vocabulary used across pages: valve/knob, the 15 reservoir IDs, and the PureScore 2.0 terms (Managed state, Trajectory, Modifiability, Companion vector, Representativeness, Coverage).
findings.fix: Add valve/knob, the reservoir IDs and the six companion-vector dimensions to the §4 glossary so cross-page references resolve.

findings.finding: Pillar codes (CV/MET/REN/HEP/INF/HEM/ENDO/BCM/NUT/SLP/FIT/MCS) and reservoir codes are used unexpanded before the reader meets their definitions (Doc 06 §4.1, Doc 07 §4, baselines, personas).
findings.fix: Link first use per page to the pillar glossary / Doc 02 / Doc 04.

findings.finding: HikmaEngine vs PureScore scope reads inconsistently: brand/title is HikmaEngine and the index hero says “PureScore is one subsystem”, but the rest of the wiki is PureScore-dominant and the boundary is asserted only once.
findings.fix: Add a one-line “HikmaEngine vs PureScore” scope note to conventions §1.

findings.finding: INF (Inflammation pillar) vs INFL (Inflammatory-load reservoir) are intentionally distinct but visually near-identical and never disambiguated on the same page; likewise NUT (pillar) vs NUTR (action class).
findings.fix: Add a one-line footnote distinguishing INF/INFL and NUT/NUTR where they co-occur.

findings.finding: Static scan is healthy: 0 broken inter-page links across the wiki.
findings.fix: No action — recorded as a baseline.

findings.finding: 57 cross-links target class-model.html#<ClassName> (e.g. #Marker, #Pillar). class-model.html has no such static ids — those anchors are generated by the class-explorer JS at runtime.
findings.fix: Verify the class explorer honors location.hash on load (scrolls/opens the target class); otherwise these deep-links land at the top.

findings.finding: Doc 05 (PureScore 2.0) has no in-content inbound link from any other page (reachable only via nav/prev-next).
findings.fix: Add a contextual link to Doc 05 from Doc 03 and/or the overview.

findings.finding: Uses a parallel economic-MONIAC vocabulary (“Behavioral Knobs”, “Pharmacological (Rx)”, “Outcomes (GDP gauges)”, “BIOMONIAC”) never reconciled with Doc 04’s canonical terms (valves, float gauge, leakage λ). “GDP gauges” has no gloss for clinician/product readers.
findings.fix: Add a one-line legend mapping knobs=valves, gauges=pillar contribution; drop/explain “GDP”.

findings.finding: Standalone full-screen app with no “what this is” opener and no link back into the wiki; reads as an orphan to all three audiences.
findings.fix: Add a short in-page intro line and a “← back to Doc 04 / Tech Wiki” link.

findings.finding: Calculation Explorer has no lead intro — jumps from crumbs into the cockpit UI; “cockpit” / “one engine, one JSON” is dev-jargon with no plain gloss.
findings.fix: Add a one-line lead explaining what the explorer does and for whom.

findings.fix: Let index own the visual map and conventions own the binding table; cross-link instead of restating.
